name: Jagerpilotens sidste mission
summary: From Yugoslavia to Afghanistan, Iraq, Syria and Libya, Thomas 'MET' Kristensen has been involved when Denmark sent the Air Force into action. Now he is flying his last mission and looking back on a life over the world's hot spots.

name: The Best of Us
summary: The Best of Us dramatizes a landmark case that reshaped the fight for accountability: a relentless legal war that stretched nearly a decade to secure almost $1 billion in compensation for first responders who fell gravely ill in the wake of 9/11.

name: Más allá de la sociedad
summary: The story of Flight 571 did not end on the day the survivors were rescued from the Andes. For them, and for the families of those who did not return, the hardest part was about to begin. Whilst silence reigned amongst those directly involved, the rest of the world continued to try to understand what had happened through books, films and documentaries. But how does one rebuild a life after such a tragedy?

name: I Can Grow It
summary: I Can Grow It follows Aaron Roach Bridgeman and his young "Garden Buds" as they uncover the magic of nature in a colourful inner‑city garden, from tiny seeds to buzzing bees and harvest-time surprises. Packed with music, hands‑on fun and simple ideas to try at home, the series shows that anyone can grow something — anywhere.

name: Daggerheart: Azerim
summary: Baradun and the Dickheads return, and this time they have landed in Daggerheart! What begins as a light-hearted adventure in the Beast Feast campaign frame, filled with bizarre creatures & questionable cooking, soon reveals a much darker mystery.

name: Lavender
summary: A story about love, identity, and the relationships that have no name — and no less meaning for it. Appu and Mohak have built a life together in Mumbai. When circumstances force a lavender marriage into their home, all three lives change in ways none of them planned.

name: Jesser's Ultimate Kickoff
summary: Jesser and friends take on epic, high-energy soccer challenges like goal-scoring contests and mystery pool jumps for the entire family to enjoy!

previousepisode.name: Score The Goal, Win The Prize

name: Shergar: The Racehorse and the IRA
summary: Shergar: The Racehorse and the IRA is a gripping two-part docuseries telling the extraordinary story behind one of racing's most infamous mysteries. After a record-breaking Derby victory made Shergar a global sensation, armed men abducted him from a County Kildare stud farm in 1983, sparking ransom demands, political speculation, and a mystery that remains unsolved.

name: Goodman: Too Big To Fail
summary: The story of Larry Goodman's rise, fall, and resurgence, revealing how he survived crises and controversy to dominate Ireland's meat industry.

name: Let's Tug It!
summary: As an unpopular club, the Mingcheng tug of war team is led by an unreliable coach named Lei Ming, who gathers eight newcomers with various personal motives to form a team on a whim, preparing them to compete in professional competitions. They suffer a devastating defeat in their first match and are ridiculed. Thus, they start the "rise from the ashes" battle, stumbling yet growing. While gaining friendship, how will they continue to follow their original intentions and fulfill their promises to each other?

name: In the Dead of Winter
summary: In the dead of winter, a mentally ill woman stops a passing vehicle to report that her husband has committed murder. Her shocking accusation leads detectives Shen Dongliang and Wu Hongbing to uncover the truth behind a series of gruesome dismemberment murders. But before the dust can settle, a string of new crimes erupts—a deadly savings bank robbery, the disappearance of a teenage girl, and a violent carjacking spree. As Shen and Wu pursue the perpetrators, they are drawn into a devastating human tragedy that will forever alter both of their lives.

name: To Love & Cherish
summary: To help support her family, Daran gave up her dreams of higher education to start working immediately after high school. Unfortunately, she struggles to find work, eventually taking a job as a security guard at a broadcasting company. But unexpectedly, she runs into her ex-boyfriend Rangsiman, now a powerful television executive. Daran and Rangsiman were deeply in love in their teens but separated over painful misunderstandings and secrets kept from each other. Rangsiman himself is now engaged to another woman, but he finds himself drawn back to Daran, wanting to understand why she broke up with him and what led her to her current life circumstances. Can they find a way to forgive each other — and will they rekindle their old spark?

name: Aperture R&D
summary: After losing a fellow scientist, Nik and Charles must decide how much they're willing to risk for the Lab Team of the Month title.

name: Sayonara Noir
summary: A former organized crime detective and a brilliant but socially awkward psychologist team up at the newly established Crime Victim Support Office at Tokyo's Nishi-Ikebukuro Police Station. Together, they use contrasting approaches to support crime victims and bereaved families, helping them overcome their trauma and move forward in life.

name: Monkey Wrench
summary: The series follows the misadventures of cut-rate mercenary monkey duo Shrike and Beebs as they cruise the galaxy in search of decent-paying contracts.

name: Atlas and the Stars
summary: Atlas is determined to set off for the stars, but things take a wild turn when her attempt to steal a starship doesn't go as planned. After mysteriously getting tossed across universes, Atlas and Atmosphere have no choice but to team up together if they ever want to make it off of the strange dying planet, Quasonia.

name: Sugar and Spice
summary: Pixie and Molly are arch enemies, as different as sugar and spice. During the 1920s, they are forced to leave home to attend high school — together. They travel hundreds of miles from the tiny settlement of Coolwong, deep in the Australian outback, to a big country town — together. The girls begin a new life with a new family. Together they fight, laugh, join the Girl Guides, fly in a biplane, discover Rudolph Valentino — and together, they grow up to understand one another. A warm, humorous and exciting story of two very strong-willed girls and the development of a most unlikely friendship.

name: Rewriting the Fate of Jiang Hui
summary: Ye Shishi has just accepted Yu Chengli's confession when her best friend, Jian You, claims she's back from ten years in the future. Jian You warns Ye Shishi that Yu Chengli is a scumbag and tells her to stay away from him. She also reveals that her own future husband, Jiang Hui, will kill his father on the night the college entrance exam results come out. To save Jiang Hui, Ye Shishi teams up with Jian You and Chen An, who lives next door to Ye Shishi and has secretly loved her for years. Jiang Hui himself also joins them, and the four work together to rewrite his fate.

name: Код а‑ля Рус
summary: In the "Code à la Rus" project with Tatiana Morozova, our designers, together with the queen of economy renovations, Ksenia Shakhmatova, will rethink the code à la Rus in a modern style. All this is for business owners to breathe new life into their creations! 8 different establishments in the country will receive a new interior.

name: Rachael Ray's Tasty Travels
summary: Where can you get a burger for a buck in the Big Apple? How about fresh oysters on the half shell at 2 a.m. in Boston? Travel guru Rachael Ray is back with insider tips and travel secrets that will turn your next vacation into a delicious, affordable feast. From the sweetest ice cream shop to the perfect spot to stage a picnic, Rachael shares tips from around the country and the world. Hop on board for some tasty travels!

name: Suikoden: The Anime
summary: Two young boys… the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom – a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region. The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return. Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war. The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question.

name: That genius is obsessed with his fake girlfriend
As Scheduled
summary: Singer Jin Xi makes a disastrous crossover into acting, only to be ridiculed online for his poor performance. Refusing to give up, he decides to reinvent himself by stepping into the world of musical theatre, determined to prove his critics wrong. By chance, Jin Xi falls for the cold, perfectionist musical director Ning Jin, and an unexpected kiss sparks undeniable chemistry between them. Fate brings them together again at an audition, where Ning Jin—who has little respect for idols crossing into musicals—is far from impressed. Subjecting the newcomer to relentless training and impossible standards, he pushes Jin Xi to his limits. Despite being ostracized by senior cast members, sabotaged by rivals, and scrutinized by the public, Jin Xi perseveres through grueling rehearsals, gradually shedding his idol image and discovering his true potential. His dedication slowly earns the respect of both the theatre company and the demanding director. As they face misunderstandings, career setbacks, family burdens, heartbreak, and reconciliation, the two join forces to save a struggling theatre troupe and bring a new production of A Chinese Ghost Story to the stage. Through countless challenges behind the curtains, their bond deepens, they heal one another, and together they lead the musical to a triumphant premiere.

name: Life In The W
summary:
Through exclusive behind-the-scenes access, Life In The W captures the realities of life at the highest level of women's basketball, offering viewers a front-row seat to the sacrifices, pressures, leadership responsibilities and defining moments that come with being among the game's elite athletes.

Across six episodes, audiences will experience the intensity of the WNBA season from multiple perspectives: a reigning superstar continuing to elevate the game, a leader helping shape the future of the league, and a veteran icon balancing championship aspirations with a legacy already cemented among the sport's all-time greats.

name: Your Time Starts Now
summary:
Set in the Taskmaster universe, the new show builds on the at-home ingenuity of earlier incarnation The Button, which Horne devised and narrated in 2018, and HomeTasking that saw Horne on a mission to entertain a world stuck in 2020's lockdown.  

Your Time Starts Now will see UK households compete against one another while tackling a host of his typically devious tasks without ever leaving their homes. Five teams of friends and families across the UK will need to display creativity, lateral thinking, speed, knowledge and teamwork if they want to win.

name: An Impossible Way to Die
summary: DS Katie Salter is happily solving everyday crimes until fate drags her into an impossible murder mystery. Four people sat around a table seemingly set for a dinner party – except they are all dead. The only clue is a scorpion crawling out of one of the victim's mouths…

name: Kissed by the Rain
summary: Plaifon works as a social worker for children and women. She meets a boy named Mawin. Mawin and his mother are on the run from an abusive father and hope to find shelter at the foundation where Plaifon works. When his mother suddenly dies, Mawin's world comes apart at the seams, and Plaifon is the only support in his life. Plaifon knows that love can give and take everything from a person, leaving a long trail of regret. She decides to leave Mawin to avoid the unwanted mistake. Will their paths cross again? Can they ever let go of their past?

name: Homestead Family Survival
summary: Homestead: Family Survival explores the biblical art of homesteading, farming, and holistic living.

previousepisode.name: A Forest of Food Pt 2: Community

name: Икорный барон
summary: Sergey Bortnik arrives in the large provincial city under the guise of a new state fisheries inspector. In fact, he is an investigator for particularly important cases of the Investigative Committee. Here Bortnik meets his old love Liza, now the wife of the local oligarch Zbruev, a friend of his youth. But Bortnik did not come here to arrange his personal life. The Caviar Baron appeared in the city - powerful and elusive, cruel and resourceful. Together with district police officer Ivan Kashin, Bortnik is looking for the Baron - but he turns out to be too cunning.

name: Bluey Cake Off
summary:
Join two famous friends as they go head to head in a playful baking adventure, each will have to follow instructions by baker Tigga Mac and try to recreate a delicious bake inspired by Bluey.

From a longdog yule log to the recreation of the Heelers' House, watch as the duo mix, decorate and mould their creations while sharing plenty of laughs along the way. Once all finished, Tigga will choose an honorary winner… but the real winner is having fun in the kitchen.

previousepisode.name: Chattermax Cake with Myf vs Rove

name: Wir werden groß!
summary: Over the past two years, VOX has provided insights into the interaction and developmental stages of kindergarten children in the documentary format ‘The Mysterious World of Children'. Tom, Mert, Paulina, Abigail and the other children have now started school. They were once again accompanied by cameras for the two-part documentary ‘Wie werden groß!'. The first-graders are accompanied for one episode each in a primary school and in an adventure centre. Viewers can witness how the eleven girls and boys have developed since their kindergarten days. But not only the children, but also the parents are asked to take scientific tests - and suddenly feel reminded of their own childhood. For the first time, developmental psychologists Prof. Dr Sabina Pauen and Prof. Dr Moritz Daum also take a close look at the parents' behaviour.

name: A Little Reunion
summary: This story focuses on China's notorious college entrance exam, the "gaokao." It follows three seniors in high school and their families as they navigate the ups and downs of their lives whilst preparing for this exam that they believe will determine the trajectory of the rest of their lives.

name: ESPN Jeopardy!
summary: ESPN Jeopardy! is the ultimate match-up between the worldwide leader in sports and the world's leading quiz show. Hosted by Emmy®-winning and Monday Night Football broadcaster Joe Buck, "ESPN Jeopardy!" features sports commentators and celebrity sports fans as they face off to experience the thrill of victory and the agony of defeat in a new arena: the Alex Trebek Stage. With material covering the full spectrum of ESPN content, this is "Jeopardy!" for sports fanatics. Contestants will represent charities of their choice as they compete in a tournament-style event for the $500,000 grand prize and the title of "ESPN Jeopardy!" champion.

name: Jupiter Island
summary: The series is set on the ultra-exclusive Jupiter Island where the privileged world of professional golfers and their wives fractures when a mysterious outsider arrives — and a secret threatens golf's reigning power couple.

name: Spy School
summary: Spy School revolves around Ben Ripley, who may only be a teenager, but he's already pegged his dream job: CIA or bust. Ben is not surprised when he is recruited for a magnet school with a focus on science — but he's entirely shocked to discover that the school is a front for a CIA academy.

name: Тест на верность
summary: Anastasiya is a well-known family psychologist. Thanks to her work, many couples have overcome the crisis and found harmony in the family. Nastya herself has been happily married to Vladimir for fifteen years. They love each other and run a family business together.

name: Fatal Conflicts - The Rise and Fall of Civilisations
summary:
Four ancient leaders. Two epic wars. Civilisations clash in a battle for supremacy – rewriting history forever. 

Fatal Conflicts: the Rise and Fall of Civilisations is a two-part documentary exploring two defining ancient rivalries: Xerxes vs Themistocles in the Second Greco-Persian War, and Hannibal vs Scipio in the Second Punic War. In each, a dominant empire, Persia or Carthage, faces a rising force, Greece or Rome.

name: The Happy Mess Method
summary: Experts Sabrina Soto and Jennifer McCartney help clients develop practical, sustainable home organization methods. Their "Happy Mess Method" offers achievable solutions instead of focusing on decluttering or perfectionism.

name: Always Remember
summary: Always Remember follows Pae and Liu, two successful professionals who have secretly been in a relationship for two years despite working as business rivals. Their carefully hidden romance is shattered after an accident causes Pae to lose every memory from the previous two years, including the time she fell in love with Liu. Suddenly, the woman she once loved becomes a complete stranger. To make matters even more complicated, people around Pae begin convincing her that Liu is actually her greatest enemy. Unable to reveal the truth, Liu decides to stay by her side and slowly help her rediscover the feelings they once shared. Meanwhile, an arranged marriage and escalating corporate disputes leave the couple racing against time before their future disappears completely.

name: The Secret Creatures of Jao
summary: This magical series takes place deep in the heart of the Okavango Delta in Botswana. Isolated by the surrounding flood water, a collection of secretive and mysterious creatures are imprisoned on the paradise island of Jao.

name: Символы русского флота
summary: The documentary series *Symbols of the Russian Navy* (produced in Russia) explores the history and key attributes of the nation's Navy, tracing its evolution from the era of Peter the Great. The series covers pivotal stages in the fleet's development, highlighting traditions, shipbuilding, and the symbols of naval power.

name: На разломе эпох
summary: The film's authors will attempt to answer the question: what was the role of the intelligentsia as a kind of spiritual and moral barometer of Russian public life, and the extent of its participation in those turbulent and fateful events during the First World War.

name: Evolution
summary: From a single spark of life, through millions of generations, animals have become diverse, weird and beautiful. Chris Packham tells the incredible story in astonishing new detail.

name: The Adam Ray Show
summary: Same host. Different characters. All chaos. Each week, Adam Ray taps into his roster of alter egos to interview famous guests — and no one is safe.

name: Jackie, Ethel, Joan: The Women of Camelot
summary: They were more than Washington wives. They were part of an American dream known as Camelot. With strength and cunning they upheld their public image by concealing their private truths. Jackie, Ethel and Joan had little choice.

name: City '68
summary: City '68  was a anthology drama set in the fictional, bustling Lancashire city of Fylde. Supposedly located on the north bank of the River Ribble—geographically nestled between Preston and Blackpool—Fylde was imagined as a massive industrial hub home to over three-quarters of a million residents. The series used this fictional backdrop as a microcosm to explore the emerging social, economic, and personal conflicts of late-1960s urban British life.

name: Chotto Matou yo, Harutora-kun
summary: Iki Kishida is a high school senior who struggles to connect with others, choosing to hide his true expressions behind a mask. Enter Harutora Kurobe, a straightforward and fiercely devoted freshman who sees right through the barriers. Despite being complete opposites, their paths cross, sparking an unlikely bond filled with the warmth, awkwardness, and heart-aching tenderness unique to adolescence. As they navigate the bittersweet waters of first love, they must confront their own vulnerabilities in a deeply moving journey of youth and self-growth.

name: The Secret of Secrets
summary: In The Secret of Secrets, symbologist Robert Langdon races against ancient forces and time to rescue his girlfriend, missing scientist Katherine Solomon, and her groundbreaking manuscript whose discoveries have the power to forever change humanity's understanding of the mind.

name: Awakening of the Tomb Leader
summary: Chen Guzhou, the legendary Tomb Leader, falls off a cliff after a deadly battle with the Corpse King of Miao Territory. Saved by the heiress of the Mechanism Clan, he hides his true identity as a servant and keeps his true power concealed—until warlords and old enemies threaten the entire clan. Forced to reveal his lost arts, Chen fights to save his people and uncover the secrets of the thousand-year-old Gu Tomb.

name: Born Again
summary: Top influencer Gu Xiaotang's grand wedding turns into a murder scene, orchestrated by her husband, best friend, and agency. Trapped in an infinite time loop of that very day, she dies repeatedly. After several brutal cycles, she awakens and uses her curse of unlimited resets, teaming up with Dr. Ye Shen, the only one who follows her through the loops, to take revenge on her killers. Just as victory seems near, the loop resets earlier: one week before the tragedy. Gu Xiaotang realizes she must stop the source of pain before it begins and fight for a future worth living.

name: Medical Examiner Dr. Qin: Bones of the Past
summary: While the city is dredging a riverbed, human remains are unearthed. Medical examiner Qin Ming discovers that the victim is a woman from an old case years ago. On Qin Ming's birthday, sunspot activity causes his toy walkie-talkie to connect with his father, Qin Tian, 30 years in the past. Qin Ming warns Qin Tian about an explosion and saves him, but this triggers the Rainy Night Hammer Killer serial case. Two generations of police officers work together across time to solve the case and uncover the truth.

name: Jin Wan Yue Guang Hen Mei，Cha Xiang Si Yi
El Señor de la Querencia
summary: Set in 1920s rural Chile, the story follows José Luis Echenique, a deranged and abusive landowner who rules his estate, "La Querencia," with an iron fist. His empire of terror is threatened by the return of Manuel Pradenas, a revolutionary outsider who falls for Echenique's oppressed wife, Leonor.

name: El Señor de la Querencia
summary: The days in Querencia are about to end. The unexpected arrival of Manuel Pradenas, a revolutionary worker who returns from the north to say goodbye to his dying mother, will put in check the authoritarian hegemony of José Luis Echeñique in his traditional hacienda and in his marriage with Leonor Amenábar. Thus, the family life of the Echenique Amenábar family and his three children, Ignacio, Luis Emilio and Teresita, will change forever, collapsing the rigid values, abuses and impositions that reigned in Querencia for years.

name: Témpano
summary: The life of a police officer is not easy, or at least if you are Nicolás Duarte, a cunning young man who is assigned the mission of protecting Amparo Benavente, a mysterious girl who comes to visit and in passing to play revenge for the events that occurred. 8 years before the beginning of the story. But, what he doesn't know is that just 20 years before, Álvaro Grau had a relationship with his mother, but due to a dark secret they distanced themselves.

name: A névtelen vár
summary: In this story set during the French Revolution and the Napoleonic Wars, a mysterious Hungarian nobleman, Count Vavel, rescues Marie—the heir to the executed French royal couple—from the ruthless Republican agents hunting her, and hides her in the "Castle of the Nameless," a deserted fortress by Lake Fertő.

name: Within the Frame
summary: Within the Frame is a popular documentary series broadcast by Museum TV that allows viewers to explore the masterpieces and lives of history's greatest painters. It provides an inside look at renowned collections, focusing on legendary artists like Leonardo da Vinci, Rembrandt, and Claude Monet.

name: Sirotan
summary: Sirotan anime series follows the daily exploits of the titular fluffy, white harp seal and his animal friends as they lead cozy, laid-back lives. Based on the popular Japanese character brand by Creative Yoko, the show focuses on simple, everyday adventures designed to spread comfort and healing.

name: Icons Unearthed: Harrison Ford
summary: Icons Unearthed: Harrison Ford tells the tale of the everyman, who redefined the leading man, from a whip-cracking archaeologist to a President with a punch. This is the story of the carpenter turned actor who built an unprecedented Hollywood legacy.

name: Lunacy
summary: The series follows high school student Luna Goda, who is raised as the "child of the fire god" and forbidden to fall in love. She runs a "follower business" (cult-like enterprise) at her grandmother's acupuncture clinic. When a popular classmate named Kensho rejects Luna's romantic confession, a scorned Luna plots to exact revenge by pulling him into her follower business.

name: Rabbit Hole
summary: A 36-member cast of the world's most influential creators, including Topper Guild, Zhong, Mackenzie Turner, Matthew Beem and Jesser come together for the ultimate teen variety show.

name: Byzantium: The Lost Empire
summary: Four programmes taking an in-depth look at the rise and fall of the Byzantine empire.

name: Sword in Flames
summary: Sword in Flames begins 7,000 years ago, focusing on a woman discovered in an ancient tomb clutching precious metal. From this starting point, the series traces the revolutionaries who figured out how to melt copper and tin to forge the very first bronze sword, following its trail from West to East across the Eurasian plains.

name: Rediscovering the Arctic
summary: Rediscovering the Arctic is an acclaimed 8-part documentary produced by CCTV. It explores the history, environment, indigenous cultures, and modern scientific expeditions of the Arctic region, detailing China's historic and ongoing relationship with the extreme north.

name: Virgin Love Hell
summary: After joining a dating survival show, "Hot Dating Zone," at Su-a's request, Solji is assigned overwhelming physical-affection missions and gets entangled in relationships with three different guys, which turns out to be set up by Su-a to humiliate her. Now, Solji has to find a way to escape from this chaos full of betrayal and excitement.

name: Spread Like Wildfire
summary: Years after a painful mistake tears them apart, a ruthless but deeply loyal lawyer and a determined female reporter are forced to work together. Bound by shared secrets and regrets, they navigate a dangerous web of revenge and healing that reignites old feelings.

name: Outback Terror: The Falconio Murder
summary: Twenty-five years after the murder of Peter Falconio and Joanne Lees' escape from Bradley John Murdoch, experts uncover insights into Murdoch's motives and try to determine where Peter is buried.

name: Por el nombre de Dios
summary: A prophecy tells that the secret name of God will be revealed with the birth of a chosen child, in the last year of the millennium.

name: Paura di amare
summary: Paura di amare centers on bereavement and a romantic new beginning: after the tragic death of his wife, pharmaceutical entrepreneur Stefano Loi plunges into despair. His life changes radically when he meets Asia, a young and determined medical student; this unexpected encounter offers both of them a second chance to find love and happiness.

name: The Debut: Dream Academy
summary: The Debut: Dream Academy consists of 20 girls from all around the world on their journey to make their dream come true. As the girls go through multiple missions, they will grow and show different sides of themselves until they make it in the final debut line-up.

name: MechWest
summary: In a fantastical Wild West world, oddball Pearl West is the only one who thinks of mechs as anything more than tools and appliances. But one fateful day she stumbles upon an unlikely friend: a curious mech named Six who carries a tremendous secret. Now Pearl, aided by her stalwart brother and a quirky salesman named Casey, must brave the dangers of the untamed frontier to protect Six from dangerous bandits. The future of all the Western nations may very well rest in Pearl's hands!

name: It's Ok to Ask Questions
summary: In the GLAAD nominated series, It's OK to Ask Questions, NBC Chicago's Matthew Rodrigues showcases open and honest conversations with trailblazers in the queer community, offering a dialogue where no topic is off limits.

name: Gayle
summary: Gayle's a middle-aged woman, stay at home mom type who descends deeper into madness each week. She's frantic and desperate and will stop at nothing to maintain status in her community.

name: Bigtop Burger
summary: The surreal daily lives of the employees of the Bigtop Burger food truck.

name: kiDnap GAME
summary: Kidnappings erupt simultaneously across seven Asian cities. Families of the victims receive a chilling email: "How far will you go to save your loved one?" Each participant is given different instructions, forced to overcome trials to rescue those they love. Seven people from diverse nationalities, backgrounds, and religions are drawn into a brutal survival contest under extreme conditions—the deadly "kiDnap GAME."

name: The Drowning Pool: The Murder of Paula Leeson
summary: Gripping mystery unravelling the death of wealthy Paula Leeson.

name: Победители
summary: Famous actors, television presenters, bloggers and correspondents ask questions to veterans of the Great Patriotic War. Heroes will tell about the dramatic events of the past and an important contribution to the overall Victory. Veterans will also share the details, personal life and observations of their contemporaries. How did moral ideals help in shaping the generation of winners? And thanks to which the veterans managed to stay in active intellectual and physical form despite the turmoil experienced?

name: A Different Breed
summary: A Different Breed follows 18 very talented pooches and their handlers as they compete in three annual live events, including high-flying disc routines, head-to-head weave pole racing, intricate dog agility courses and diving dog competitions.

name: Murder in Suburbia
summary: In December 2007, a quiet Surrey town is shaken by a horrific murder. But who killed Sharon Birchwood? Detectives follow a trail to Thailand in one of the most bizarre murder cases in recent memory.

name: Surgery Secrets of the Super Rich
summary: With privileged access to elite clinics in London and Manchester, this series follows world-renowned doctors delivering bespoke, undetectable results for high-net-worth clients, revealing pioneering treatments and eye-watering price tags.

name: 9 месяцев
summary: 9 месяцев is a new pregnancy show that will be with you every step of the way: from the first two lines to the long-awaited meeting with your baby.

name: Лето Победы
summary: The spring of 1945 brought the Soviet people a great victory, but World War II was not yet over. Japan continued its fierce resistance, and soon a new war—the Cold War—began. In this film, you'll see how the USSR's former allies literally transformed before our eyes into what they have now become for Russia—geopolitical adversaries. We'll take a look behind the scenes of high-stakes diplomacy and recount the Red Army's brilliant operation to defeat Japan. And we'll celebrate the 80th anniversary of the Great Victory in World War II.

name: Heartbreak Island Australia
summary: Heartbreak Island's global cast jet into Fiji and sparks fly as sixteen singles pair up. Competing to be with the one they really want and $100,000 for the winning couple.

name: The 700 Club Israel
summary: Hosted by Gordon Robertson, brings you weekly news, devotionals, interviews, and inspiring stories from the Holy Land. Discover what God is doing through CBN Israel and hear powerful testimonies of hope, faith, and humanitarian impact.

name: 20.000 leguas de viaje submarino
summary: Diego, his friends and Admiral Nemo try to save the ocean while facing great dangers.

name: Transcendence
summary: Stress, overwhelm, depression, anxiety, autoimmune disease, obesity, suicide, cancer, a midlife crisis, wondering what direction to take in your life? These are some of the biggest challenges of our time. What if you could have everything you ever imagined? What if the life of your dreams was already available? Come on a journey to discover the secrets to living a happy and purposeful life. Learn from the world's best on how you can achieve everything you've ever wanted, using what you already have. In this 5-part docu-series you'll hear from some of the world's most recognized doctors, high-performance athletes, thought leaders, and everyday people who are living a life on purpose through the power of food, mindset, and self-discovery. From personal stories and experiences of those who have been in the darkest trenches, have healed their trauma and recovered from great adversity to transcend the limitations in their own lives through to practical and approachable tools to apply this to your own life, find out how you can live a life beyond the ordinary. This groundbreaking new FMTV original series will inspire you to examine your own life more deeply and give you the tools to ultimately live a healthier and happier life.

name: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God 10th Anniversary
Miracle Living Today
summary: The hosts shed light on the testimonials of various people on the experiences of supernatural help and divine interventions in their life.

name: Trafic
summary: An ordinary father in Bucharest is forced into a world he never wanted to be part of in order to save his son. But the deeper he gets, the more he realizes that the greatest danger comes from where he least expects it. A crime drama about family, sacrifice, and choices from which there is no turning back.

name: Jan Serce
summary: A sensitive idealist, a noble and righteous man, he dreams of a true, great love. Despite turning 40, he is still looking for 'the one'. Before fate unexpectedly turns out to be favourable, he experiences various emotional adversities. Reflective story of the unchanging human longing for goodness and honesty.

name: Doña Bella
summary: A poor woman falls for a rich man but faces obstacles due to class differences. She's abducted by a powerful businessman who desires her, leading to heartbreak and revenge against those who wronged her.

name: El elegido
summary: El elegido tells the story of Andrés Bilbao, an ambitious lawyer married to Verónica San Martín, with whom he has an autistic daughter named Alma Bilbao. Coming from a humble background, Andrés is a professional who aspires to become a partner alongside Oscar Nevares Sosa at the law firm where he works.

name: ZDFzeit
summary: From politics and the world of royalty to consumer protection: these high-end documentaries offer space for all the topics of our time. Sometimes insightful, sometimes feel-good, never boring.

previousepisode.name: Prinz und Rebell – Harry gegen das Königshaus

name: Chaofan Jinhua
summary: The story follows young Ming He, whose "junk superpower" mutates into a special entity called the "Dependent Spirit" after colliding with the "Goddess" meteorite, triggering a series of adventures and crises.

name: Double Lives of Suburban Wives
summary: Double Lives of Suburban Wives follows six couples in the St. Louis area whose everyday routines from carpools and cul-de-sacs to church and community gatherings coexist with a second, more private side of their lives. Beneath the polished façade, they've built lucrative and unconventional second lives, forging an unexpected bond rooted in navigating lives that many people would never expect.

name: Cocktail Wars
summary: In a series of themed challenges, Cocktail Wars pits America's buzziest mixologists against each other in a lively, high-stakes competition with $10,000 on the line in every episode. Each installment showcases a fast, fiery battle of skill, creativity, humor, and flair. From playful flavor combinations to eye-catching technique, the focus is on having a good time, taking risks, and serving up drinks with personality. Each shake, stir, and splash could be the winning touch or the one that sends them home. It's a cocktail competition where the vibes are high, the drinks are strong, and the bragging rights are everything.

name: Below
summary: Calvin Penney is a big hearted but stubborn fisherman living in a small Newfoundland town, who's still haunted by his father's mysterious death from decades ago. When an unidentified sea creature begins terrorizing his hometown, Calvin must fight to hold his close-knit community together. Determined to keep his son Wade and the rest of his family safe, he teams up with a visiting marine researcher to confront the creature and reveal the island's buried secrets before it's too late. Blending local myth, thrilling suspense, and heartfelt humor, this twisty six-part limited series dives into themes of family, community, and change - both terrifying and inevitable.

name: Shifter
summary: Shifter is set in the near-future, where a banned cosmetic procedure lets people change their faces on the fly, creating a new underground industry of Shifters, who can become anyone you want, for any purpose you can imagine, for a fee. Rose is making a name for herself as one of the best, but the more she gives to her gigs, the more she risks losing herself.

name: Connecting to You
summary:
Chia-kai possesses the unique ability to see the ""connections"" between people: red for love, green for family, and blue for hostility. Yet, he himself is constantly threadless—until he meets Ta-wei, a skeptical detective. Between them, a mysterious silver thread appears, which makes Chia-kai determined to uncover the meaning of this unprecedented bond. As their lives intertwine, the silver thread begins to shift colors, forcing them to confront feelings they can no longer ignore.

Adapted from a hit Taiwanese BL novel, Bruce Chiu and Liu Yu-ren form an irresistible paranormal crime-solving duo.

name: The Loyalty Game
summary: A group of women runs a unique business: luring men to expose their infidelity. Their newest client, Ana, lives a seemingly perfect life with her devoted husband-until doubt creeps in. As he starts to distort her reality, Ana teams up with a loyalty tester, and their search for truth spirals into a dangerous game of secrets, manipulation, and power-where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

name: Dessert Person with Claire Saffitz
summary: Claire Saffitz is a dessert person. She likes cakes and cookies and pies and believes that no meal is complete without something sweet at the end. In her recently published book, "Dessert Person," Claire celebrates and defends her love of desserts and empowers reluctant home bakers to work with new ingredients, attempt new techniques, and bake with more confidence. Join Claire in her home kitchen as she highlights recipes from the book in this new baking series to help you take your baking skills to the next level.

name: Виталя
summary: Vitalina has been a district police officer for many years and is accustomed to devoting far more energy and time to her job than to her own family. But the day after their thirtieth wedding anniversary, her husband, scientist and professor Anatoliy Rozanov, unexpectedly decides to leave her for his eighteen-year-old secretary, Sveta, who is also expecting his child. Anatoliy explains his unseemly act as revenge. He took paternity tests and discovered that only two of their three adult children are truly his. This means his wife was the one who started cheating on him first. Vitalina decides to prove his innocence and secretly collect DNA from the children-Natalya, Mikhail, and Elena-for retesting. Vitalina moves into each of their homes in turn, diligently setting about resolving their marital problems.

name: Время для двоих
summary: 1991. A group of tenth-graders goes to Moscow. There, one of the students, Alena, meets a boy, Mitya, who leaves her his address and phone number. But Alena loses the note. 2010. Dmitry Platonov, editor-in-chief and one of the co-founders of a large, successful Moscow publishing house, goes on a business trip to N-sk. There, many business events await him, including an interview for a local newspaper. The journalist turns out to be that very Alena. Dmitry doesn't recognize her: the 16-year-old girl has become a beautiful woman. She has loved him all these years and recognizes him immediately, but doesn't want to admit it…

name: Samantha
summary: Samantha is a 1998 Venezuelan telenovela produced by Venevisión. The story follows Samantha, a free-spirited country girl who saves a wealthy playboy, Luis Alberto, from a plane crash. They fall in love, but their romance is threatened by dangerous family secrets, ruthless rivals, and Luis Alberto's memory loss.

name: Mi querida Isabel
summary: Mi querida Isabel is a Mexican telenovela that centers on Isabel Rivas, a simple, beautiful and happy young girl and a dedicated law student who supports her dysfunctional family following the presumed death of her mother two decades earlier. Her family is noble and affectionate but her father hides his addiction to the alcohol and the truth about the mother of Isabel and Marcos, who is alive and unjustly put in jail. Her younger brother Marcos pursues a rebellious lifestyle focused on music and easy money. While working as a waitress in the university, Isabel meets a nice guy, Juan Daniel. A beautiful, pure and enthusiastic love starts between Juan Daniel and Isabel. Juan Daniel is an architect who is meant to be successful. His family is rich and lives in luxury, but also they have their own secrets. The mother of Juan Daniel is a dominant and bitter widow who controls the life of her children. The core plot revolves around Isabel's involvement in the case of Sagrario, a woman imprisoned for 20 years on charges of murder she insists she did not commit. Unaware of their blood relation, Isabel fights to prove Sagrario's innocence and ultimately welcomes her into the family home upon her release.

name: Araw Gabi
summary:
It is a tale of how love can bring light and gloom in a person's life and how a deep, dark secret can make or break the blooming relationship between Michelle and Adrian. 

Michelle is a girl with a bright and sunny disposition. Despite the hardships in life, she managed to get by because her Mamay and Papay taught her always to see the good in every situation. She has her eyes set on bagging the Tranquila Resort account because it will boost her career. 

Adrian's life, on the other hand, is full of darkness. He is the CEO of the Olvidar Group of Companies, of which Tranquila Resort, a vacation spot situated in El Paraiso, is part. Because of a sin he committed 18 years ago, he is considered a beast by his employees and an outcast in his home town. 

Michelle and Adrian start on the wrong foot, and as they cross paths again, Michelle learns that Adrian is the owner of Tranquila Resort. As she sets foot on the island of El Paraiso, she finds out about Adrian's life and the mystery behind the lighthouse she has been dreaming of. 

What is the relation of El Paraiso to Michelle's dream? As Mich enters Adrian's life, will she be the light that will make his life bright again?

name: Cuando hay pasión
summary: Inés and Luis Guillermo... Marisela and Diego Andrés... Two love stories unfolding against the backdrop of a fierce struggle between two prominent families: the Núñez and the Malavés.

name: I Left My Heart in Sorsogon
summary:
I Left My Heart in Sorsogon is a romance-drama story about Celeste, a young woman from Sorsogon who has reinvented herself in Manila as a fashion designer and socialite.

Celeste is successful on both the personal and professional front. Aside from being a celebrated fashion designer, she is also the toast of high society as she is dating the most eligible bachelor around, Tonito Wenceslao III.

For some unexpected reason, Celeste finds herself coming back to her hometown, Sorsogon, to take care of some family matters.

While in Sorsogon, Celeste looks back on her previous life there, and makes a discovery about herself. She also unexpectedly crosses paths again with her ex-boyfriend, Mikoy.

Will Celeste choose the bright lights of Manila with Tonito or will she leave her heart and live a possibly quieter life in Sorsogon with Mikoy?

name: First Yaya
summary:
First Yaya is the aspirational, fairy-tale-like story of an ordinary woman who gets to lead an extraordinary life as the nanny of the children of a widower Philippine Vice-President who eventually becomes the President by accession and election.

Despite social and familial obstacles and struggles, the bond between yaya Melody Reyes and country leader Glenn Acosta prevails and blossoms into something beautiful, heart-warming, and exciting. But unbeknown to them, a dark secret from the past—involving both their families—could possibly destroy their intricate and already-complicated relationship, forever threatening their "happily- ever-after".

name: Russia: A Journey with Jonathan Dimbleby
summary: Jonathan Dimbleby explores ten thousand miles of one of the world's most awe-inspiring countries.

name: Heart Attack
summary: In a post-pandemic world, gene therapy has saved the human race from disease but has given birth to Variants: people with powers so unique, the government denies their human rights.

name: Solterita y a la orden
summary: Solterita y a la orden follows the entertaining life of Valeria, a woman who decides to stay single and focus on her success. Her life changes when a handsome radio host becomes obsessed with winning her heart, sparking a fun-filled battle between love and freedom.

name: Un nuevo amor
summary: A young woman struggles to discover her true origins and find her place in the world, while confronting the secrets of her past and discovering true love.

name: Say Yes to the Dress: Benelux
summary: A fashion show, wedding story, and family therapy all in one; Say Yes To The Dress: Benelux. In one of the best bridal salons in the Netherlands, a team of advisors guides brides-to-be through the wedding!

name: Richelieu
summary: Approach to the vital and historical trajectory of one of the fundamental characters in the history of France, decisive for the centralization of the state and the consolidation of Catholicism throughout the country. Relentless, of an exceptional political and military intelligence and very influential in the reign of Louis XIII, of which he was not a simple prime minister. Crossed out and reputed to be a despot, ambitious, harsh and cruel, perhaps there was some truth in it. Alexander Dumas and his musketeers gave him some visibility.

name: O Beijo do Vampiro
summary: A love story interwoven with supernatural elements, drama, humour, and the struggle between good and evil.

name: Вернуть любой ценой
summary: USSR, 1983. Dina goes for an internship at a medical hospital in Afghanistan and faces not only the horrors of war, but also true love, which seems to have no place on this earth. Officer Gerasimov, saved by Dina, sees in her the meaning of his life and is ready to risk everything just to be with her. Having learned that Dina is in danger, he goes to a distant mountain outpost and enters into a dangerous battle to save his beloved.

name: Khung Saneha
summary: Marasri is the most beautiful girl in the countryside and her father is the richest man. However, she has a difficult and proud temper and is crazy about likay, which makes it difficult for people to get along with her. She's madly in love with a likay actor, Wichan, to the despair of her father who won't have a likay actor as his son-in-law. So when Lieutenant Anon comes in town on an undercover mission to secretly investigate a murder in a likay troupe, under the fake identity of Nai Mai, a simple worker, her father sees an opportunity. Marasri's father hires Anon to protect her, but in fact, he hopes to matchmake them. Like that, not only his precious daughter will stop being obsessed about likay actors and won't bring him one at home, in addition, he'll have a strong police officer as a son-in-law to protect his daughter!

name: Love Adhura
summary: A simple guy meets a charming damsel who cons him out of his car, leading to unexpected twists and dramatic consequences involving his overbearing father and a staged romance at their resort.

name: Thibaan in Love
summary: A series which follows the reality of rural society. It tells the story about the lovely Thai native soccer team and the problem in the village and the culture of the northeastern part of Thailand.

name: First Lady
summary:
Since assuming the role of the country's First Lady, Melody becomes overwhelmed by all the changes and the responsibilities she now holds. As she tries to emulate past First Ladies, Melody learns that she can just be herself, despite holding a prestigious role in the government.

However, with her Princess Diana-like appeal to the masses, the close confidantes of President Glenn Acosta worry that the First Lady may overshadow his presidential campaign.

name: Tom vs Time
summary: At age 40 Tom Brady is taking on his toughest opponent yet: time. Watch as he balances his growth on the field with fatherhood, fortyhood and life in the spotlight. Follow Tom Brady on his journey vs. time.

name: The Brave Man
summary: Thongdee was transferred to Ban Huai Jorakhe after opposing a crime backed by a powerful figure. There, he meets Ploy, the daughter of Preecha, whom Thongdee suspects of being involved in illegal activities. Ploy, disillusioned with the police, believes there are no good cops left and fights for justice and equality against powerful criminals. When Thongdee learns of his superior's corruption, he realises he must battle both the criminals and the corrupt officers.

name: Musée Eden
summary: The story takes place in 1910 in Montreal, Quebec, while a killer terrorized the city. In the same period, Florence and Camille Courval, two sisters originating in French Manitoba inherit the Eden Museum, where statues of wax in connection with criminal news are housed.

name: The Soulmate Rings
summary: YouTuber Soda has made a fortune selling products online. She's an incredible saleswoman, beautiful, smart, confident, has tons of friends, is an excellent problem-solver, and has many admirers. The man she's about to marry, however, is just an ordinary veterinarian, Dindaen. Dindaen specialises in cattle breeding. He's easygoing, unpretentious, genuine, straightforward and harmless. None of Soda's friends care for Dindaen, but no one can change her mind. When the couple start to feel unsure about each other before their wedding ceremony, their rings miraculously transport the two back in time to prove their love, stability, and vows.

name: Kahani Hamari... Dil Dosti Deewanepan Ki
summary: The story revolves around 4 people named Shivin, Gauri, Ahan, and Kia. Gauri is a lower class girl who has a passion for education, while Shivin, Ahan, and Kia are rich kids of business parents. Shivin and Ahan were best friends until a series of miscommunication caused Ahan to get angry on Shivin, although it was never his fault. This causes Shivin to get angry on his mother thinking it is her fault, but the truth is she is also innocent. Gauri bumps into Ahan a few times, so they start to lightly recognize each other. On the other hand, Gauri and Shivin meets through some misunderstandings which causes Gauri to have a bad image of Shivin, but in reality, Shivin is a very down-to-earth guy who cares for people. The misunderstanding is soon sorted out when Shivin saves Gauri from goons and shelters her for a while in his house.

name: Donal's Family Kitchen
summary: Recipes Donal knows his own family will devour — from smoky chicken tacos to speedy pastas. A blueprint for managing the madness life throws at you and still getting supper on the table.

name: Ready. Daddy. Go!
summary: Ready. Daddy. Go! follows Michel, a gay man unexpectedly left by his husband. Despite having nothing, he refuses to give up his dream of becoming a father, exploring adoption, surrogacy, and new love as a newly single parent.

name: Time:out
summary: Ellis and Brecht seem like a dream couple. Until Brecht suddenly decides to take a time-out. One month without a relationship and job to figure out what he wants.

name: La Méditerranée révélée
summary: The turquoise waters of the Mediterranean are home to exceptional biodiversity. Join researchers studying the seabed to better protect it on a dive to discover the aquatic plants of Port-Cros Island and the powerful currents of the Strait of Messina—not to mention the large marine mammals of the Pelagos Sanctuary, where dolphins, whales, fin whales, and sperm whales are right at home.

name: La mujer de Lorenzo
summary: La mujer de Lorenzo follows Laurita, an elegant socialite who plots to make her rich and devoted husband, Lorenzo, fall in love with another woman. She does this to dodge a strict pre-nup so she can leave him for her personal trainer without losing her massive fortune.

name: Totally ‘90s House
summary: Popular nineties television idols with a passion for design and renovation will go step by step back into the iconic decade as they search for America's homes frozen in time. Totally ‘90s House a true blast from the past will follow two celeb teams as they scour the country for houses stuck in the 1990s—think honey oak cabinets, sponge-painted walls and mirrored closets—with each team ultimately picking their perfect throwback in need of a major overhaul.

name: Strike!
summary: Behind every woman stands an insecure man. Or so it seems in the comedy series about the Hendrickx family, headed by ex-commissioner Marcel and businesswoman Rita. Their three daughters each lead their own lives, together with their partners. The sons-in-law and son Jeroen form the "Kloefkappers" and discuss their lives weekly at the bowling alley. As long as the men are together, they feel on top of the world and their self-confidence knows no bounds. Then they can handle any problem – or so they think. Once left to their own devices again, however, they quickly transform back into those hesitant creatures desperately trying to keep their heads above water. Fortunately, behind each of our insecure men stands a strong woman who does know how to handle things, and her husband. It is this age-old tension between the sexes that provides the very recognizable humor in Strike.

name: Oh! My Dreamy Daddy
summary: A mother, Qin Mu Xuan, reconnects with a cold-blooded CEO, Gu Zi Jin, years after a conspiracy separated them, forcing them together for the sake of their secret, adorable young son, Qin Xiao

name: The Tiger's Path
summary: Three brave brothers are humiliated by the brutal Sua Int of Huaysuarong. Kan, Krieng and Krai have to break the oath to remain peaceful. Their hearts are also burning as their girls leave them for their foes, especially Waree, Kan's number-one enemy. The three brothers have to remain courageous in this tough combat.

name: World War II: Endgame
summary:
World War Two was a conflict of immeasurable scale, a Total War, laying waste to entire nations, changing the world forever. From this devastation, new powers would emerge. Allies would become enemies, an Iron Curtain would fall across Europe, and a Cold War would begin. Who were the great players that shaped the modern world, and how did the Cold War emerge from the Endgame of World War Two?

World War II: Endgame is a four-part series combining military history and big picture geopolitics. It's the story of the "Grand Alliance" of World War Two, the unlikely team of Great Britain, the Soviet Union and the US that came together to defeat Hitler's Nazi regime, before fracturing and turning on itself. With expert interviews, archival footage brought to life by cutting edge colourisation, this series explores the origins of a conflict that took the world to the edge of Armageddon.

name: The Cadburys
summary:
The Cadburys is a warm-hearted family drama following the visionary Cadbury family, the underdogs of the cocoa world, on their journey towards creating the world-famous Cadbury's chocolate bar.

In 1860s Birmingham, when chocolate as we know it doesn't yet exist, two very different brothers, Richard and George Cadbury, find themselves in charge of their family's failing cocoa business. Between them, they have the radical genius and burning ambition to turn Cadbury's into one of the world's most beloved confectioners. But first, they must learn to trust and rely on each other. And to stop bickering for long enough to actually invent some chocolate! Their sister Maria is navigating her own role within the family and the business, but things become even more complicated when she falls in love with Cadbury's biggest rival, and is forced to question where her true loyalties really lie. Infused with historical delights and magical invention, The Cadburys is about how we build, break and rebuild the bonds of family - and how the sweetest things in life are rarely simple.

name: Малые родины большого Петербурга
summary: A special project of the St. Petersburg TV channel about the historical districts of the city, with their mood, cultural environment and iconic architectural objects. "Small Motherlands" are the districts of St. Petersburg where the city began and continues. The history of the place and time, together with the authors of the program, is told by St. Petersburg residents: old-timers, local historians, writers, actors, artists.

name: Морской волк
summary: Based on the novel by James. London. About the collision of strong characters, love and outcast among men, doomed to loneliness and misunderstanding.

name: Станица
summary: In the Kuban town of Lushchinskaya, law and order are not exercised by local autonomy but by the Volkov clan, headed by "Donya" Nadezhda Alekseevna Volkova and her eldest son, Nikolai, who will be the protagonists of creating a tragedy.

name: Sonho Meu
summary: A woman loses custody of her child, a girl left in an orphanage by her impatient aunt. The girl escapes and is sheltered by a sweethearted elder, while her mother fights to get her back.

name: Chicks
summary: Chicks is a two-hander dramedy set in the rapidly gentrifying neighborhoods of old Boston. The show follows Chickie and Doreen, two estranged half-sisters who are both struggling to get by when their wise guy dad unexpectedly kicks the bucket. Their only inheritance is a legacy of two-bit crime that inspires them to run increasingly audacious frauds. As their con grows, so does their odd-couple bond, as they each start to fill the father-shaped hole in the other's heart.

name: A Mountain Can Hold Two Tigers
Behind Bars: Officer Cam
summary: Behind Bars: Officer Cam takes viewers inside two of the country's most pressurized correctional facilities, where sheriffs equip every officer with body-worn cameras to transform how their jails operate. Through raw, first-hand footage, the series reveals what it takes to run a modern American jail. Once viewed primarily as tools of oversight, bodycams have become catalysts for change—driving smarter training, stronger decision-making, and safer outcomes for officers and inmates alike.

name: Super Market
summary: Super Market is the new Italian Prime Original comedy series written and directed by the collective Il Terzo Segreto di Satira on the tragicomic events of Eury, a chaotic neighborhood supermarket that risks closure.

name: Caminos cruzados
summary: A sensitive and intelligent woman begins working at the company of a powerful, manipulative man, sparking a tangled love triangle filled with secrets and deception.

name: Bajo un mismo rostro
summary: After the murder of her father and brother, Irene Saldivar travels to Greece. There she meets and falls in love with entrepreneur Alexis Theodorakis. Carlos is the administrator of Irene's fortune and cooperates with Alejandro in a rotten and corrupt business where he marries rich women, kills them, and obtains their fortune. When Carlos finds out about Irene's marriage to Alexis, he formulates a plan to kill Alexis and obtain his fortune. During Irene and Alexis' honeymoon, Carlos' plan succeeds when the boat Alexis travels in explodes. A desperate and pregnant Irene returns to Mexico, where she falls in love with Dr. Diego Covarrubias. However, Irene is forced to leave him for the sake of her friend Carolina, since Carolina loves him and has cancer. Since Alejandro isn't able to win Irene's love, Alejandro gets in her life and forces her to marry him or risk losing her son - all of this as part of another plan Carlos formulated so he and Alejandro plot Irene's death in another fatal catastrophe.

name: La dama del norte
summary: La dama del norte tells the incredible story of Diana García, a young woman who flees to Madrid to escape a terrible past and who, together with her friends Penélope and Maricarmen, ends up leading one of the most ruthless drug cartels in 1990s Spain. In a world ruled by men, Diana prevails where they fall: she negotiates, she leads, and she survives. But her power begins to waver when Detective Medina — the only one capable of seeing the woman behind the criminal legend — crosses her path. The relationship between Diana and Medina, as intense as it is impossible, will put their loyalties in check: as the police and the cartel tighten the noose, both must choose between justice, revenge… or a love that could doom them both.

name: A Minha Sogra é Uma Bruxa
summary: Alberto detests his mother-in-law, Elvira, and finds himself in desperate situations without realizing that she and her children are sorcerers. His wife, Amanda, gave up her supernatural powers to lead a normal life with him but has to deal with her mother's constant interference. Origin: The comedy is a humorous, partial adaptation of the famous classic American series *Bewitched*

name: Bao An Dai Dui Peng Qi Da Li Shen Bei
Seis hermanas
summary: The story of Seis Hermanas takes place in 1913. The Silva sisters are the life of high-society gatherings. Beautiful, well-mannered, kind, and refined, the six sisters enjoy a trouble-free existence until a terrible event changes their lives forever.

name: Ontwaak
summary: What happens when your worst enemy is the only person who can help you? In Ontwaak, the story revolves around Melissa Human, a psychiatrist who starts working at Noordlig, a home for extremely dangerous patients. But behind the high walls, more than just patients await her. She discovers a sinister cult, Horisonne, that has taken in her daughter, and is led by her ex-fiancé.To save her daughter, Melissa must cross her own boundaries and rely on a brilliant serial killer. However, every answer leads to a new danger; every choice has a price. This is not just a fight against a cult – it's a fight against the darkest depths of the self.

name: Monsters of God
summary:
Filmmaker Eric Goode follows his first love – reptiles – into the dark and gonzo underworld of exotic animal smuggling. In this global network, everyone is chasing the ultimate prize, whether it be owning the rarest of species, claiming the biggest fortunes, or taking down the most elusive criminals. The billion-dollar criminal enterprise is fueled by extreme obsession for these creatures, driving many to push the boundaries of laws and environmental ethics. As he digs deeper, Goode uncovers a labyrinth of outlaw traffickers, bombastic collectors, and the dogged law enforcement agents on their tails. 

Unfolding over decades, Monsters of God traces the evolution of the reptile trade as it skirts the Endangered Species Act of 1973 and grows into a secretive, high-stakes world of backroom dealings and fanatical collectors. With unprecedented access to the major players, from traffickers to animal enthusiasts to federal agents, Goode unravels a web of larger-than-life characters who run a complex international crime ring. A thrilling exposé of a hidden underworld, Monsters of God warns of the devastating impact of the insatiable desire for the forbidden, and how this mad obsession is pushing some species to the brink of extinction.

name: Vi på Saltkråkan
summary: Single father Melker Melkersson spends summer vacations on Saltkråkan island with his kids. After fixing up a dilapidated cottage, they return yearly. Pelle, one of the kids, has adventures with friends Tjorven, Stina, and dog Båtsmann.

name: Nano
summary:
Nano is a story that explores themes of destiny, love in its purest form, and an infinite spirit that triumphs over vengeance. 

Camila and Manuel are two individuals who share a passion for the ocean and marine life. Camila first sees Manuel—known as "Nano" to his friends—through the massive glass walls of the aquarium where he works. One day, their eyes meet, and they feel an immediate attraction.

name: Paris is Always a Good Idea
summary: Career-driven nonprofit executive Chelsea Martin travels to Paris with her confident rival-turned-ally, Jason Knightly to secure a major donation but a heartfelt message from her late mother – and a loving push from her sister Annabelle – sends her on an unexpected journey to reconnect with the three great loves she once left behind. From the rolling hills of Ireland to the magic of Paris and the sun-kissed vineyards of Spain, Chelsea retraces old footsteps and discovers that sometimes moving forward means first looking back.

name: Make it Right 2026
summary: When two high school friends, Fuse and Tee, get drunk together after experiencing unexpected heartbreak, a night of blurred lines transforms their friendship—forcing them, along with their circle of classmates, to navigate the messy, confusing realities of secret romance, identity, and growing up.

name: Ghost of Love
summary: This is the story of Wang Ta-khian village, where a beautiful woman called Phraethong once eloped with her lover Muen Khiri, after being forced to marry Phloeng. However, they were chased and caught by Phraethong, who in his rage killed Meun Khiri. Having witnessed the death of her lover, Phraethong committed suicide. The two dead lovers were buried together under a Ta-khian tree. Hundreds of years passed, however, Phraethong could not enter the rebirth cycle due to committing suicide. Instead, she became Mae Ya Wang Ta-khian, an entity revered by the villagers. All she could do now was wait to meet her lover Muen Khiri again.

name: Самые важные открытия человечества
summary:
Humanity could not exist without constant progress, the discovery and implementation of new technologies, inventions, and discoveries.
What is a discovery? A discovery is always something new, something that didn't exist before, and something that will revolutionize our familiar way of life. It can be the result of lengthy scientific research, or it can come suddenly—as bright as a solar flare.
After all, if Nikola Tesla, as a child, watching lightning during a thunderstorm, had believed his parents' explanation that it was a manifestation of God's wrath, we would hardly be using electricity today. And if Albert Einstein hadn't turned the scientific world upside down with his theory, it's unclear what modern physics would be like. What about the theory of evolution? The discovery of atoms? And the countless truly brilliant discoveries made by great scientists of past centuries? Without all of this, the world we are accustomed to would look completely different. And yet, which particular great scientific discoveries played a decisive role?

name: Маугли. Городские джунгли
summary: A young savage, Andrei, is brought to Moscow to be civilized. But it's in the concrete jungle that "Mowgli"'s knowledge of the pack's laws comes in handy as he investigates mysterious murders.

name: Точка взрыва
summary: As you know, a sapper only makes mistakes twice, and the first time is when choosing a profession. But an employee of the unique division of the Moscow police - the Engineering Department - Major Denis Kramer cannot imagine his life without his favorite job.

name: The Reclaimers: Made in Suffolk
summary:
Set at Tinkers Barn, a unique salvage yard in the Suffolk countryside, the series follows three generations of the Warnes family as they rescue, restore and repurpose treasures that others leave behind.

Alongside boss Andy is his wife and business partner, Hayley, who focuses on the design and detail that helps transform forgotten finds into desirable pieces. Their son Jonah has been learning the reclaimers trade his whole life, while master craftsman Pops (Andy's dad) – who brings decades of experience and expertise - will be stopping by later in the series. Together, this special family dynamic is a force to be reckoned with as they work to preserve objects from Britain's past while building the future of the family business.

Each episode sees the Warnes on their mission to save everything they can find, leaving no stone unturned. With the opportunity to salvage items from old buildings and demolition sites, they try to find a use for anything discarded. From the bricks and mortar of an abandoned property to tired home and garden furnishings, the team scour the likes of castles, schools and hospitals to breathe new life into what was left behind.

name: Umthetho
summary: A skilled young public prosecutor is pulled into a brutal prison syndicate led by the brother she thought she lost. Forcing her to choose between justice and family, law and survival, truth and betrayal.

name: Sheep
summary: Oliver, a young ram, lives contentedly in a flock of sheep and firmly believes that sheep tame humans. He is determined to earn the "Blue Mark" that grants entry to paradise. When he sneaks in among the chosen ones, he discovers the truth. Unfortunately, his warnings fall on deaf ears among the other sheep.

name: Dongda Gao Wu Xueyuan
summary: In a city experiencing a spiritual resurgence, demons threaten to invade. Qin Yu, a boy born with a useless spiritual root, unexpectedly awakens divine power within him and is chosen to inherit the mysterious and powerful cultivation technique, "The Life-Giving Power of All Things." After joining the Dongda Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yu gradually befriends a group of chivalrous companions, cultivating and growing together to protect their school and their planet .

name: Game Day Murders
summary: Through firsthand accounts from families, teammates, and those closest to the cases, each episode of Game Day Murders paints a vivid cultural portrait of the inner workings and emotional stakes of teams, fanbases, and communities faced with tragic consequences.

name: Snapping Golden Bough
summary: Amid fierce court rivalries in the Great Wei Dynasty, Shen Suhe is forced to marry the Second Prince, enduring humiliation before losing her family and life. Reborn on her wedding day, she pretends to be foolish to uncover the truth, joining forces with Prince Yu, Mu Yunzheng, to clear the injustice, defeat the Empress and the Fourth Prince, and eventually live in seclusion together.

name: Shelldon
summary: Shelldon follows the adventures of Shelldon, a Yoka Star Shell, and his lively sea-creature friends on their underwater exploits. Set in the idyllic coral reef community called Shell Land, the inhabitants also include Shelldon's best friends, Herman, a Hermit crab and Connie, a Cowry shell, and a colorful array of sea characters.

name: The Magical Hour
summary: Mark, the gay CEO of an entertainment company, is killed and is given 100 days as a ghost to settle his unfinished business. Cin is a kind shy woman who lives a harsh life with her brother Sun and cruel stepmother and stepsister. Mark discovers he can possess Cin, and together they set out to help Mark's family and business, and solve the mystery of his death (with help from his brother Mate). Along the way, Mark helps Cin improve her own life and find love.

name: Tills döden skiljer oss
summary: When family lawyer Malin and her husband Tobias have the neighbours over for a drink, the police come knocking. The babysitter supposed to be looking after Malin and Tobias's children has been murdered, and Tobias is the primary suspect.

name: Young Farts Trailer Parts
summary: Small-town brothers Jagger and Dawson run Young Farts RV Parts, a multi-million-dollar business where they turn trailer trash into cash. Between outrageous schemes, chaotic stunts, and big-hearted hijinks, these brothers chase one wild idea after the next - all for the love of their family and the empire they're building

name: Park'd with Abby Hornacek
summary: Take an adventure with Fox Nation host Abby Hornacek as she travels across the country exploring America's most beautiful natural treasures.

name: Way Back Home
summary: A story about a group of eight teenagers who have bonded inside a bar & restaurant named "HOME". ("HOME" belong to the eldest of the group : Ken who take care everyone and his younger sister "Khaopod," the only girl in the group.) Every members in the group have their own personality, different origin even their own faculty in university. Such as Pol, Man, Jay study at Faculty of Engineering. Sand, Bank study at Faculty of Medicine. Khaopod, Yuan, and Well study at Faculty of Communication (1st year). Friendship and story of problems in each families reveal teenagers' life nowadays. And causing the group of them. All of them think that "HOME" is a home for them. Being the place which contain love, understanding, helping and consulting. Then one day Khaopod accidently shoot a picture, which turn the problem to "HOME". This story will absolutely change her life and all friends' life.

name: Come Dine with Me: Celebrity Philippines
summary: A group of celebrities take turns hosting their own dinner parties and grading each other. Over the week they battle for the title of best host, and the chance to win a grand cash prize for their chosen charity.

name: Metro Veinte
summary: The show revolves around Juana, an active teenager who, as her nickname suggests, sees the world from a height of 1.20 meters. At her new high school, she battles the societal taboos surrounding disability, bodily diversity, and youth sexuality. The series is known for being a powerful, authentic coming-of-age story that uses both traditional screen formats and virtual reality to dive into her fantasies and experiences.

name: Alfred Nobel – Kärlek och Dynamit
summary: In 1875, the Swedish industrialist Alfred Nobel, inventor of dynamite, having amassed a vast fortune after overcoming a series of setbacks, was looking for a multilingual secretary. Thus, Bertha Kinsky, a penniless Austrian aristocrat earning her living as a governess, arrived at his Parisian townhouse. But their close bond, forged from intellectual complicity, was short-lived: Bertha returned to Vienna to marry Arthur von Suttner, the son of her former employers. Fleeing the scandal, the couple went into exile in Georgia, where the young woman witnessed the horrors of the Russo-Turkish War of 1877-1878. Becoming a journalist and writer, she achieved resounding success with the pacifist novel *Lay Down Your Arms!*, and then rose to the vice-presidency of the International Peace Bureau, founded in 1891. While Alfred worked on developing smokeless gunpowder-which led to him being monitored by the French secret police-Bertha tirelessly tried, letter after letter, to win him over to her cause. The last wishes of her friend, who died at the end of 1896, confirmed the high opinion she held of him: they stipulated the creation of annual prizes to honor those who had "brought the greatest benefit to humanity" in the fields of chemistry, physics, medicine, literature, and... peace.

name: Zeri Feisheng
summary: In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...

name: Nadie me dirá como quererte
summary: María Eugenia, a Venezuelan raised in Paris with free will, returns to her native country, where fate will make her undergo many changes. However, she did not imagine that she would meet Doctor Gabriel Olmedo and fall madly in love with him.

name: Родина чемпионов: Ислам Махачев
summary: Mixed martial artist Islam Makhachev spends several days in his native Dagestan, sharing his everyday life outside of major tournaments: night fishing, a farm visit, a game of padel, training, and a football match between Dagestan and Ossetia.

name: Rebirth of Reiko: A Mother's Revenge
The Battle of Stars
summary: This story is about the rise and fall of actors and celebrities within the entertainment industry. Not only is the war between the celebrities, but those who fight neck and bone to build them into who they are. People often see the war with celebrities because they are the face, but little do they know about the agents. The agents are people who know every inch and centimeter of a celebrities life, they can build you or kill your career. Every agent desires to have that #1 dara in their agency, and almost every agent will sell their soul or client for profit.

name: Until the T-Shirt Dries
summary: Sakiko is a 40-year-old editor working at a publishing company. While she is competent at her job, she can be a little lazy and absent-minded in her personal life. The story unfolds when Sakiko and her husband get involved in an accident with another couple. This incident causes the happy lives of both couples, which they had taken for granted, to suddenly crumble. Moreover, the "third Friday secret" involving her husband comes to light.

name: Ágata y Lola
summary: Lola is an extroverted, impulsive, and rule-breaking police inspector who meets Ágata, a brilliant and meticulous documentary filmmaker with autism spectrum disorder. Ágata possesses an exceptional memory and a unique talent for analyzing criminal files, while Lola brings intuition, field experience, and empathy for victims. Despite their vast personality differences, they form a perfect team and become friends while solving all sorts of complex criminal cases.

name: El otro padre
summary: With her daughter's life on the line, a doctor's search for a kidney donor exposes a secret affair and a DNA test that could shatter two families.

name: Hypersonic
summary: A known terrorist launches a surprise cyber-attack on the U.S in order to gain control over their hypersonic missiles. FBI director Karen Smith enlists the help of two ex-military black ops soldiers to hunt down the culprits.

name: ALIUS
