summary: A ruthless detective investigating a series of bizarre murders uncovers a mysterious entity known as "ALIUS," forcing him to question reality as he races toward a shocking truth.

name: The Bumble Nums
summary: Join Humble, Stumble, and Grumble as they work together to gather ingredients and prepare the most fantastic dishes from their Bumble Nums cookbook! Purple Pear Pie? Yum! Sparkling Strawberry Smoothies? Yum! Stretchy Spaghetti Surprise? Yum! Yay Bumble Nums!

name: NBA Showtime
summary: NBA Showtime on NBC is a flagship basketball studio broadcast that provides in-depth analysis, expert commentary, and comprehensive coverage of the latest storylines, trades, and highlights from across the league. The program features a rotating panel of hosts and analysts breaking down player performances and team dynamics.

name: Nogizaka Star Tanjo! Six
summary: The sixth generation members of Nogizaka46 will be taking on the challenge of singing "Showa era pop songs" and "Heisei era hit songs" for the first time in the "Nogizaka Star Tanjo!" series, which the fourth and fifth generation members previously took on.

name: She Who Blazes
summary: In Kuizhou, beauty is measured by curves, while slim women are looked down upon. After inheriting her grandmother's Yanzhi Pavilion, Fang Zhuozhuo discovers a magical rouge made from the rare Qionghua blossom that transforms her into the voluptuous beauty Qingcheng, the pavilion's celebrated mistress. To fulfill her grandmother's final wish by winning the prestigious Beauty Selection Ceremony, she must secure a steady supply of Qionghua, a flower that grows only in the private garden of the Governor's residence. Determined to obtain the blossoms, Zhuozhuo marries Chu Shengyi, the Governor's third son. When her deception is exposed on their wedding day, she is reduced to the status of a concubine. Each enters the marriage with hidden motives: Zhuozhuo seeks the precious flowers, while Shengyi hopes to use Qingcheng's identity to rescue his true love, Ye Xin, from the manipulative Lady Li. After the Qionghua garden is destroyed in a fire, the two journey together to the black market in search of new seeds. As they cultivate the flowers side by side, an unexpected bond blossoms between them. Shengyi eventually discovers that Zhuozhuo and Qingcheng are one and the same. Joining forces, they rescue Ye Xin and uncover Lady Li's long-buried crimes, including the murder of Shengyi's birth mother, exposing her before all. With the outdated obsession for voluptuous beauty finally abandoned, Zhuozhuo takes rightful charge of Yanzhi Pavilion under her own name, while Shengyi promises to wait for her return.

name: Lantern Festivalin Bianjing
summary: Set during the Northern Song Dynasty, the story follows Meng Qian, a young man from the capital city of Bianjing, who is forced into the power struggles of the imperial court and the martial world while trying to save his sister-in-law and younger sister. Caught between the Imperial City Bureau, the Liangshan heroes, Fang La's rebellion, and the hidden forces manipulating them all, Meng fights to survive. As he grows from merely protecting himself to embracing a greater sense of duty, he becomes determined to safeguard the future of the Song Dynasty. The series is a stirring tale of an ordinary man's coming-of-age, woven with themes of patriotism, family, and national destiny.

name: The Portrait of a Lady
summary:
Isabel Archer, a vivacious New World ingénue who leaves America for Old World Europe, is keen to experience all that life has to offer.

A young woman with charm and an innate intellectual curiosity, Isabel rejects a series of marriage proposals, but when she inherits an unexpected fortune that promises to grant her freedom, she falls prey to two American ex-pat schemers: the elegant Madame Merle and the charming but calculating Gilbert Osmond.

name: Secret Lives of Gypsy Wives
summary: Gypsy TikTok star Trewley Precious is the youngest daughter in her large family. Can she challenge traditional gender roles, build a lucrative social media career, and get away with it?

name: Aku Tak Membenci Hujan
summary:
Aku Tak Membenci Hujan tells the story of Launa, a beautiful and cheerful girl who falls in love with Karang, who turns out to have a split personality. However, the unfortunate man wants to kill the Karang inside him. Karang prefers to be Banu, a small child, or Agha, a rebellious and disobedient teenager.

Launa tries to get Karang back to his true self. But the man's heart is too broken to be the traumatized Karang, born of a mistake, hated for no reason, and considered worthless by his mother, leaving Karang Samudra Daneswara to live in sorrow. Will Launa find the love of Karang, who has never wanted anything in her life except a hug from Andira, her biological mother?

name: Inside The Langham: Britain's First Grand Hotel
summary: Inside The Langham: Britain's First Grand Hotel has exclusive access to the staff and guests at the luxury London hotel as it prepares for its 160th anniversary. With five kitchens under the watchful eye of Culinary Director and chef Michel Roux Jr., serving Michelin-starred cuisine, wedding celebrations and dinner events for hundreds of guests, the series reveals how The Langham competes with other high-end London hotels to attract visitors to its restaurants and rooms.

name: Коп-звезда
summary: Charismatic, sarcastic, with a flask in his pocket and demons in his head, Kit is an experienced cop who knows the streets better than any GPS. His partner is a principled and slightly naive rookie who hasn't yet become disillusioned with the system. Together, they are like a two-person rock band, forced to play on the same wavelength. Each episode is a new investigation, a new challenge, and a new way to grow their audience. But behind the likes, hype, and banners lies a genuine pain and an attempt to cope with the past.

name: Космическая экспедиция с Алексеем Столяровым
summary: As part of the project, TV presenter Alexei Stolyarov experiences every stage of preparation for a space flight: parachute jumps, training in a pressure chamber, an isolation chamber, and a centrifuge with 3G overload, dives in a hydrolaboratory simulating a spacewalk, and many other tests that cosmonauts undergo before being sent to the ISS. Throughout the project, Stolyarov, who endured colossal physical and psychological stress, was accompanied by instructors from the Cosmonaut Training Center, while Roscosmos employees facilitated filming and shared expert commentary.

name: D.O.P.E. Unit
summary: A covert crime drama set in Philadelphia, following an off-the-books undercover task force known as the D.O.P.E. Unit as it wages a secret war against powerful crime families. As violence escalates and political pressure mounts, the series explores systemic corruption, moral ambiguity, and the consequences of institutional choices in a world where loyalty and justice collide. As the operation deepens, personal lives unravel, trust erodes, and every decision carries a cost that reshapes the mission and those sworn to uphold it.

name: Da Tang Shao Nian Tian Xing Zhuan
Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies
summary: A gripping documentary series uncovering how organized crime infiltrated Hollywood across the 20th century. As stars and gangsters overlapped, the line between glamour and crime blurred through unions, financing and the hidden power brokers. From early mob influence to later scandals and crackdowns, the series reveals how deeply the underworld shaped the film industry.

name: 20/20 Britain's Most Notorious Crime Investigations
summary: A Greek paradise turns tragic. A dangerous killer could be living next door. Romance and religion are tied to the death of two elderly neighbors. A serial killer is discovered hidden in plain sight. The Royal family is linked to a deadly scandal. A high-speed car chase turns deadly. The new docuseries 20/20 Britain's Most Notorious Crime Investigations reopens six of the UK's most high-profile crime cases, bringing the prestige and journalistic power of ABC News' legendary "20/20" brand to an international audience with premium, character-driven true crime.

name: BattleBots Pro League
summary: BattleBots Pro League powered by Bright Data is the toughest robot combat event on the planet. 24 elite bots from across the globe converge on Las Vegas for the ultimate fight to the death. There are 6 Groups of 4 bots, each of which has to fight everyone in the Group. The Group winners progress to the Knockout rounds, so every fight matters and there are no second chances.

name: The Disappointments
summary: In this darkly comic series, three gay friends in their late 50s are forced to face the fact that their lives have fallen far short of what they imagined for themselves when they were in their 20s. Dreams of wealth, career success, and lasting love have faded, replaced by a growing sense of the clock ticking and an urgent need to turn their disappointing lives around - before they are literally out of time.

name: Love on the Menu
summary: Some sacrificed love for the sake of family. Others walked away from their families to protect the ones they loved. And some, believing they were acting out of love, only left deeper wounds behind. Years of misunderstanding and conflict have driven them apart, but an unexpected bond and reunion bring them face-to-face once again. As lost love, tangled family ties, and the true feelings they have long kept hidden begin to surface, even the coldest hearts slowly begin to heal. Through love, forgiveness, and the courage to understand one another, they discover what it truly means to be a family. Can the scattered pieces of a family finally find their way back to one warm table?

name: NBC Sunday Night Baseball
summary: The new Sunday Night Baseball package marks the return of Major League Baseball to NBC for the first time in more than two decades. The debut marks the beginning of a new three-year partnership between NBCUniversal and Major League Baseball and it comes on the heels of the debut season of Sunday Night Basketball, the first of an 11-year agreement between NBCU and the NBA.

name: The Affair Was Just the Beginning
summary: Park Kyung Hee appears to have it all: a thriving interior design business, an adoring social media following, and the perfect family image. To elevate her success, she orchestrates a friendship with her wealthy neighbor, Soo Jung, hoping to leverage Soo Jung's connections into an investment into her business. However, her carefully curated life unravels when she investigates rumors of her husband Lim Jae Hong's infidelity, only to discover him disposing of a dead body – and their daughter is allegedly responsible for the killing. Despite attempting to cover up the incident, they receive an anonymous message that someone has recorded them, forcing Kyung Hee to navigate a treacherous web of blackmail and deceit as they try to put their lives back in order.
